Import a video inventory into the project field data

Source: R/inventaire_video.R
importer_inventaire_video.Rd

The “Integrate” step: reads inventaire_video.gpkg (import_qgis_gpkg), reconciles each plot for which the Groma server returned a definitive result (rapprocher_arbres), derives espece from essence_arbre (map_bdforet_essence), drops the faux_positif trees, validates (valider_inventaire_video), aggregates per plot (aggregate_plot_metrics, one call per plot radius) and tags the NDP source (tag_field_data_sources, source = "inventaire_video").

Usage

importer_inventaire_video(
  gpkg,
  resultats = NULL,
  field_data_gpkg = NULL,
  plan = NULL,
  priorite = c("classique", "video"),
  region = "BFC"
)

Arguments

gpkg

Path to the inventaire_video.gpkg returned from the field.

resultats

Optional paths (files or directories) of the definitive GeoPackages of the Groma server (layer detections), e.g. from groma_telecharger_resultats.

field_data_gpkg

Optional path of the project field data (data/field_data.gpkg), created when absent.

plan

Optional sf of the original sampling plan (checked by valider_inventaire_video).

priorite

"classique" (default) or "video": which version of a plot inventoried both ways enters the main layers.

region

Character. Species region. Default "BFC".

Value

A list with placettes, arbres (video inventory after reconciliation, without faux_positif), agregats (tagged aggregate_plot_metrics output), validation, a_completer and a_verifier (subsets of arbres by etat_detection), classique_conserve (plots whose classical inventory stayed in the main layers), ndp (integer, NDP level of agregats), alertes and numeros_modifies (reconciliation) and field_data_gpkg (path or NULL).

Details

With field_data_gpkg, the video plots are merged into the project field data by plot_id, without overwriting: absent plots are added to the placettes / arbres layers; for a plot already inventoried, the version chosen by priorite stays in the main layers (the ones aggregated downstream) and the other goes to placettes_alternatives / arbres_alternatives. Every row carries a source column ("inventaire_terrain" or "inventaire_video").

Lifecycle

Experimental (spec 061).
